body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 3 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense against the triggering Action. You may gain 1 Strain to increase this bonus by 1.

surges.html: Increase any movement, barrier, or forced-movement value in this Reaction by 1.
Remove one Physical damage Condition from a living creature affected by this Reaction.
